summary: A fresh real-BB pass confirmed the final rail-free Host Monitor 0.1.2 UI: page cards/rows and compact/floating hosts have no tone-colored edge, background, border, or shadow; Critical and Needs attention retain readable semantic text and dots while Healthy text is neutral; page host buttons open neutral Radix explanations on hover/focus; compact rows remain native focusable list items with safe described explanations, neutral hover/focus feedback, a body-level viewport-positioned tooltip for any scrolled row, Tab-loop reachability, exact host focus restoration after refresh, and correct mixed hover/focus persistence. BB's global Host Monitor icon stayed neutral with no notification pseudo-element. Executable cases cover offline, disconnected, sampling, stale, failed-refresh, unavailable, malformed state/alert, malicious alert/error strings, and retained disconnected severity absent from the live fleet.
